honest_finding: PWR is essentially NOT load-bearing for the reset-to-blinking-LED path on this chip. Grepped every 'PWR' occurrence across the fetched stm32c0xx_hal_rcc.c, stm32c0xx_hal_flash.c and stm32c0xx_hal_flash_ex.c: the ONLY hit is a single '__HAL_RCC_PWR_CLK_DISABLE()' call inside HAL_RCC_OscConfig's LSE-disable path (stm32c0xx_hal_rcc.c:553), which only runs if firmware explicitly disables the LSE crystal. Unlike STM32L0 (which architectures.md SS3.3 notes couples flash wait states to PWR->CR VCORE range), STM32C0 has a single fixed voltage domain -- there is no VOS/voltage-scaling field anywhere in PWR_CR1..CR4 (confirmed against the full SVD field dump). Team-lead's brief lists PWR in the minimum peripheral set, so it is modelled below for completeness and because RCC_APBENR1.PWREN gates it (see rcc.json) -- but a simulator that stubbed PWR out entirely would still boot this specific board's blink+printf firmware correctly. This is the kind of 'false green' risk noted for GPIOAEN in rcc.json, just in the opposite direction: PWR being UNDER-modelled would not actually cause a divergence from real silicon on THIS firmware, whereas GPIOAEN being under-modelled would.

registers.name: PWR_CR1
registers.reset_value_decoded: FPD_SLP=0, FPD_STOP=1 (bit3), LPMS=010; note SVD's field list for THIS register only actually documents FPD_SLP/FPD_STOP/LPMS -- the RM's own prose for these bits was found under the shifted/garbled heading position (see chip.json extraction_caveat) and was cross-checked against the SVD field list instead of trusted verbatim.

fields.name: FPD_SLP
fields.why: Power down flash in Sleep mode. Not touched by an active blink loop (device never enters Sleep in a trivial while(1){toggle;delay;} firmware unless HAL_SuspendTick+WFI patterns are used).

fields.name: FPD_STOP
fields.why: Power down flash in Stop mode. Same scope note as FPD_SLP.

fields.name: LPMS
fields.why: Selects which low-power mode CPU deepsleep enters (Stop/Standby/Shutdown). Irrelevant to a firmware that never calls HAL_PWR_EnterSTOPMode or __WFI in deepsleep-configured mode.

deferred_registers: PWR_CR2 (C071-only, reserved elsewhere), PWR_CR3/CR4 (wakeup-pin config), PWR_SR1/SR2 (wakeup/standby status), PWR_SCR (wakeup-flag clear), PWR_PUCRx/PDCRx x6 (per-port pull config applied only when CR3.APC=1) -- all captured in other_svd.txt but out of scope for the minimum blink/printf set per the scope_note pattern used in flash.json.
